name: Horizon-Labs prompt-injection-guard small / base / large
usage: Fast prompt-injection detector for tool outputs and documents

sources.note: Recommended, 1.23 GB; leave out code/*.py and ONNX

runtimes.value: transformers text-classification on MPS, ONNX; milliseconds per chunk, 8k context

web.verdict: Newest agent-oriented injection encoder; responsive maintainer; numbers mostly self-reported
web.summary: Trained on injections in documents, web pages, email, RAG chunks and tool outputs. Vendor: macro average 0.887 vs 0.637 for ProtectAI v2; the card lists weaknesses (out-of-place tasks missed, false positives on benign agent requests).
web.scope: Released 23.09.2026 (under 3 months): all comments. Hacker News comments (Algolia), Hugging Face discussions, GitHub issues of the runtimes; Reddit blocked (no r/LocalLLaMA feedback).

comments.text: Maintainer measurements: 0.4 % flagged on 24,788 real multilingual prompts, 12.2 % on benign commands with trigger words; recommends threshold 0.9 for user turns, 0.5 for retrieved content.
